readings.title: The Golden Lampstand
readings.subtitle: Aharon Trims the Lamps
readings.text:
[Numbers 8:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[2] <dq>“Speak to Aharon, and say to him, ‘When you ascend to trim <dn>את</dn> the lamps, let the seven lamps give light in front of the lampstand.’ ”</dq>
[3] And Aharon did so. <dn>He</dn> set up the lamps to face toward the front of the lampstand, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[4] And this is the work of the lampstand: beaten work of gold, from its base to its blossoms it is beaten work. According to the pattern which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had shown <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, so he made <dn>את</dn> the lampstand.

readings.title: Cleansing of the Levites
readings.subtitle: Separation for Service
readings.text:
[Numbers 8:5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[6] <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites from among the children of Yisra’ěl, and you shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> them,</dq>
[7] <dq>and do this to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of sin offering on them, and they shall shave all their body, and shall wash their garments, and cleanse themselves,</dq>
[8] <dq>and shall take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, while you take another young bull as a sin offering.</dq>
[9] <dq>“And you shall bring <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites before the Tent of Appointment, and you shall assemble <dn>את</dn> all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>
[10] <dq>“And you shall bring <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the children of Yisra’ěl shall lay <dn>את</dn> their hands on the Lěvites,</dq>
[11] <dq>and Aharon shall wave <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a wave offering from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl – so shall they be for doing <dn>את</dn> the service of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[12] <dq>“And the Lěvites shall lay <dn>את</dn> their hands on the heads of the young bulls. And one shall be prepared as a sin offering and the other as an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to make atonement for the Lěvites.</dq>
[13] <dq>“And you shall have the Lěvites stand before Aharon and his sons, and then wave <dn>את</dn> them, a wave offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[14] <dq>“Thus you shall separate <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites from among the children of Yisra’ěl, and the Lěvites shall be <dn>Mine</dn>.</dq>
[15] <dq>“Then after that the Lěvites shall go in to do service in <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment, when you have cleansed <dn>את</dn> them and waved <dn>את</dn> them as a wave offering.</dq>
[16] <dq>“For they are given ones, given to <dn>Me</dn> from among the children of Yisra’ěl. <dn>I</dn> have taken <dn>את</dn> them for <dn>Myself</dn> instead of all who open the womb, the first-born of all the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>
[17] <dq>“For all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ěl are <dn>Mine</dn>, both man and beast. On the day that <dn>I</dn> struck all the first-born in the land of Mitsrayim <dn>I</dn> set <dn>את</dn> them apart unto <dn>Myself</dn>.</dq>
[18] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> have taken <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites instead of all the first-born of the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>
[19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> have given <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites as a gift to Aharon and his sons from among the children of Yisra’ěl, to do the service of <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl in the Tent of Appointment, and to make atonement for the children of Yisra’ěl, that there be no plague among the children of Yisra’ěl when the children of Yisra’ěl come near the set-apart place.”</dq>
[20] Thus Mosheh and Aharon and all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ěl did to the Lěvites according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh concerning the Lěvites, so the children of Yisra’ěl did to them.
[21] And the Lěvites cleansed themselves and washed their garments, and Aharon waved <dn>את</dn> them, a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and Aharon made atonement for them to cleanse them.
[22] Then after that the Lěvites went in to do <dn>את</dn> their service in the Tent of Appointment before Aharon and his sons as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh concerning the Lěvites, so they did to them.
[23] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[24] <dq>“This applies to the Lěvites: From twenty-five years old and above let him come into active service in the service of the Tent of Appointment,</dq>
[25] <dq>and at the age of fifty years they retire from active service of the service, and serve no more,</dq>
[26] <dq>but they shall attend with <dn>את</dn> their brothers in the Tent of Appointment, to guard the duty, but shall do no service. Thus you shall do to the Lěvites regarding their duties.”</dq>

readings.subsection: The Second Passover and the Cloud
readings.title: The Second Passover
readings.subtitle: Provision for the Unclean and the Stranger
readings.text:
[Numbers 9:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the first new moon of the second year after they had come out of the land of Mitsrayim, saying,
[2] <dq>“Now, let the children of Yisra’ěl perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ at its appointed time.</dq>
[3] <dq>“On the fourteenth day of this new moon, between the evenings, perform <dn>את</dn> it at its appointed time. According to all its laws and right-rulings you perform <dn>את</dn> it.”</dq>
[4] And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ěl to perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ.
[5] So they performed <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ on the fourteenth day of the first new moon, between the evenings, in the Wilderness of Sinai. According to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ěl did.
[6] But there were men who were defiled for a being of a man, so that they were not able to perform the Pěsaḥ on that day. So they came before Mosheh and Aharon that day,
[7] and those men said to him, “We are defiled for the being of a man. Why are we withheld from bringing near <dn>את</dn> the offering of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at its appointed time among the children of Yisra’ěl?”
[8] And Mosheh said to them, “Wait, let me hear what <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commands concerning you.”
[9] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[10] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘When any male of you or your generations is unclean for a being, or is far away on a journey, he shall still perform the Pěsaḥ of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[11] <dq>On the fourteenth day of the second new moon, between the evenings, they perform <dn>את</dn> it – with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they eat it.</dq>
[12] <dq>They do not leave of it until morning, and they do not break a bone of it. According to all the laws of the Pěsaḥ they perform <dn>את</dn> it.</dq>
[13] <dq>But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, and has failed to perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ, that same being shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not bring the offering of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at its appointed time – that man bears his sin.</dq>
[14] <dq>And when a stranger sojourns among <dn>את</dn> you, then he shall perform the Pěsaḥ of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. He shall do so according to the law of the Pěsaḥ and according to its right-ruling. You have one law, both for the stranger and the native of the land.’ ”</dq>

readings.subsection: The Second Passover and the Cloud
readings.title: The Cloud and the Fire
readings.subtitle: The Divine Guide
readings.text:
[Numbers 9:15] And on the day that the Dwelling Place was raised up, the cloud covered <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place, the Tent of the Witness. From evening until morning it was above the Dwelling Place like the appearance of fire.
[16] Thus it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
[17] And whenever the cloud was taken up from above the Tent, after that the children of Yisra’ěl would depart. And in the place where the cloud dwelt, there the children of Yisra’ěl would camp.
[18] At the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl departed, and at the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped. They remained camped as long as the cloud dwelt above the Dwelling Place.
[19] Even when the cloud lingered many days above the Dwelling Place, the children of Yisra’ěl guarded <dn>את</dn> the Charge of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and did not depart.
[20] And so it was, when the cloud was above the Dwelling Place a few days: according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped, and according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they would depart.
[21] And so it was, when the cloud dwelt only from evening until morning: when the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they departed. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was taken up, they departed.
[22] Whether two days, or a new moon or a year that the cloud lingered above the Dwelling Place to dwell upon it, the children of Yisra’ěl camped, and did not depart. But when it was taken up, they departed.
[23] At the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped, and at the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they departed. They guarded <dn>את</dn> the Charge of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, at the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh.

readings.title: The Ascending Offering
readings.subtitle: A Sweet Fragrance to YeHoVaH
readings.text:
[Leviticus 1:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> called to Mosheh, and spoke to him from the Tent of Appointment, saying,
[2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, and say to them, ‘When anyone of you brings an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you bring <dn>את</dn> your offering of the livestock, of the herd or of the flock.</dq>
[3] <dq>‘If his offering is an ascending offering of the herd, let him bring a male, a perfect one. Let him bring <dn>את</dn> it at the door of the Tent of Appointment, for his acceptance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[4] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on the head of the ascending offering, and it shall be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.</dq>
[5] <dq>‘And he shall slay <dn>את</dn> the bull before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall bring <dn>את</dn> the blood and sprinkle <dn>את</dn> the blood all around on the slaughter-place which is at the door of the Tent of Appointment.</dq>
[6] <dq>‘And he shall skin <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering and cut <dn>את</dn> it into its pieces.</dq>
[7] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon the priest shall put fire on the slaughter-place, and lay the wood in order on the fire.</dq>
[8] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall arrange <dn>את</dn> the pieces, with <dn>את</dn> the head and <dn>את</dn> the fat on the wood which is on the fire on the slaughter-place.</dq>
[9] <dq>‘But its entrails and its legs he washes with water. And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> all of it on the slaughter-place as an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[10] <dq>‘And if his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats as an ascending offering, let him bring a male, a perfect one.</dq>
[11] <dq>‘And he shall slay <dn>את</dn> it on the north side of the slaughter-place before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall sprinkle <dn>את</dn> its blood on the slaughter-place all around.</dq>
[12] <dq>‘And he shall cut <dn>את</dn> it into its pieces, with <dn>את</dn> its head and <dn>את</dn> its fat, and the priest shall arrange <dn>את</dn> them on the wood which is on the fire on the slaughter-place.</dq>
[13] <dq>‘But the entrails and the legs he washes with water. And the priest shall bring <dn>את</dn> it all and burn it on the slaughter-place. It is an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[14] <dq>‘And if the ascending offering of his offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is of birds, then he shall bring <dn>את</dn> his offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.</dq>
[15] <dq>‘And the priest shall bring it to the slaughter-place, and shall wring off <dn>את</dn> its head, and burn it on the slaughter-place, and its blood shall be drained out at the side of the slaughter-place.</dq>
[16] <dq>‘And he shall remove <dn>את</dn> its crop with its feathers and throw <dn>את</dn> it beside the slaughter-place on the east side, into the place for ashes.</dq>
[17] <dq>‘And he shall split <dn>את</dn> it at its wings, but not sever it. And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> it on the slaughter-place, on the wood that is on the fire. It is an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Grain Offering
readings.subtitle: Fine Flour, Oil, and Frankincense
readings.text:
[Leviticus 2:1] <dq>‘And when anyone brings a grain offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, his offering is to be of fine flour. And he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it,</dq>
[2] <dq>and he shall bring it to the sons of Aharon, the priests, and he shall take from it his hand filled with fine flour and oil with all the frankincense. And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> it as a remembrance portion on the slaughter-place, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[3] <dq>‘And the rest of the grain offering is for Aharon and his sons, most set-apart of the offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by fire.</dq>
[4] <dq>‘And when you bring as an offering a grain offering baked in the oven, it is of unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened thin cakes anointed with oil.</dq>
[5] <dq>‘But if your offering is a grain offering on the griddle, it is of fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil.</dq>
[6] <dq>‘Divide <dn>את</dn> it into bits and pour oil on it, it is a grain offering.</dq>
[7] <dq>‘And if your offering is a grain offering, in a stewing-pot, it is made of fine flour with oil.</dq>
[8] <dq>‘And you shall bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> the grain offering that is made of these, and shall present it to the priest, and he shall bring it to the slaughter-place.</dq>
[9] <dq>‘And the priest shall take from the grain offering <dn>את</dn> a remembrance portion, and burn it on the slaughter-place, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[10] <dq>‘And the rest of the grain offering is for Aharon and his sons, most set-apart of the offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made by fire.</dq>
[11] <dq>‘No grain offering which you bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is made with leaven, for you do not burn any leaven or any honey in an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made by fire.</dq>
[12] <dq>‘Bring <dn>את</dn> them to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> as an offering of the first-fruits, but they are not burned on the slaughter-place for a sweet fragrance.</dq>
[13] <dq>‘And season with salt every offering of your grain offering, and do not allow the salt of the covenant of your <dn>Elohim</dn> to be lacking from your grain offering. With all your offerings you bring salt.</dq>
[14] <dq>‘And if you bring a grain offering of your first-fruits to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, bring <dn>את</dn> for the grain offering of your first-fruits green heads of grain roasted on the fire, crushed heads of new grain.</dq>
[15] <dq>‘And you shall put oil on it, and lay frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.</dq>
[16] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> the remembrance portion, from its crushed grain and from its oil, with all the frankincense, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Peace Offering
readings.subtitle: The Fat Belongs to YeHoVaH
readings.text:
[Leviticus 3:1] <dq>‘And if that which he presents is a slaughtering of peace offerings, if he is bringing it of the herd, whether male or female, he brings a perfect one before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[2] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and slay it at the door of the Tent of Appointment. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall sprinkle <dn>את</dn> the blood on the slaughter-place all around.</dq>
[3] <dq>‘And from the slaughtering of peace offerings he shall bring a fire offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>את</dn> the fat that covers <dn>את</dn> the entrails and <dn>את</dn> all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq>
[4] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys, and <dn>את</dn> the fat that is on them by the loins, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver which he removes with the kidneys.</dq>
[5] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon shall burn <dn>את</dn> it on the slaughter-place upon the ascending offering, which is on the wood, which is on the fire, as an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[6] <dq>‘And if that which he presents is from the flock, for a slaughtering of peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, male or female, he brings a perfect one.</dq>
[7] <dq>‘If he is bringing a lamb as <dn>את</dn> his offering, then he shall bring <dn>את</dn> it before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,</dq>
[8] <dq>and shall lay <dn>את</dn> his hand on the head of his offering, and slay <dn>את</dn> it in front of the Tent of Appointment, and the sons of Aharon shall sprinkle <dn>את</dn> its blood on the slaughter-place round about.</dq>
[9] <dq>‘And from the slaughtering of peace offerings he shall bring near – as a fire offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – its fat, all the fat tail which he removes close to the backbone, and <dn>את</dn> the fat that covers <dn>את</dn> the entrails and <dn>את</dn> all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq>
[10] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> the fat that is on them by the loins, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq>
[11] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn them on the slaughter-place as food, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[12] <dq>‘And if his offering is a goat, then he shall bring it before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,</dq>
[13] <dq>and shall lay <dn>את</dn> his hand on its head and slay <dn>את</dn> it before the Tent of Appointment. And the sons of Aharon shall sprinkle <dn>את</dn> its blood on the slaughter-place all around.</dq>
[14] <dq>‘And from it he shall bring his offering, as an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>את</dn> the fat that covers <dn>את</dn> the entrails and <dn>את</dn> all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq>
[15] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> the fat that is on them by the loins, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq>
[16] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn them on the slaughter-place as food, an offering made by fire for a sweet fragrance. All the fat belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[17] <dq>‘An everlasting law throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you do not eat any fat or any blood.’ ”</dq>
